title: Charred arrow
content:
# Charred arrow

Internal ID: ArrowCharred | Type: Arrow | Source: Black forge | Usage: Bow ammunition | Crafting Materials: Charred bone x4, Feathers x2, Ashwood x8

# Introduction

Charred arrows are ammunition for bows and are the next direct upgrade from Carapace arrows.

## Availability

• Charred bone can be found in the Ashlands and is dropped from Charred Warriors, Marksmen and Twitchers.
• Ashwood can be obtained from the Ashlands by cutting down or chopping up burned trees.

Categorias: Weapons, Arrows, Black forge recipes
